gate: GPU_ONE_STEP_V1 - with GPU atom forces (GPU_PAIR_VECTOR_V1) and CPU kicks / drift, does one full KDK step give exactly the CPU E2 state, endpoint for endpoint, including domain stops? Performance only after correctness.
classification: ONE STEP ONLY - NOT TRAJECTORY CORRECTNESS

baseline.this_branch: claude/gpu-one-step-v1 in the main checkout (no worktree); clean at start
baseline.frozen_untouched: no GPU_PAIR_VECTOR_V1 / G0 file, no existing evidence, no executor is modified

reference_semantics.step: as stream.run and e2_pair_parallel_v1.run_parallel: with F_s = forces(q_s) (an impulse already: h * G * d, h = K.H = DT / 2): p_half = p_s + F_s; q1 = q_s + p_half * cdt (cdt = LI.c(K.CDT) lifted at p; elementwise q + (p * cdt)); F1 = forces(q1); p1 = p_half + F1. No extra 1/2, no merged formulas, no reordering
reference_semantics.domain_stop: forces raises DomainStop(kind, step) at the first non-PROVEN pair in canonical order; nothing after it runs (no second kick)
reference_semantics.note_on_commutativity: mpmath's single interval product is symmetric (mpi_mul(a, b) == mpi_mul(b, a) bit for bit), so 'CDT * p' instead of 'p * CDT' cannot change any endpoint; the sealed structural fault is drift = q + (p * DT) / MASS instead

division_of_work: GPU: q -> pairs -> G -> J -> canonical atom reduction -> F (GPU_PAIR_VECTOR_V1 kernels, unchanged); CPU: p = p + F and q = q + p * cdt (mpmath iv at p). No momentum / position update on the GPU
executor: GpuForceExecutor keeps one CUDA context, the uploaded model and constants for p, and the position / pair / atom buffers for N, and reuses them for every force evaluation (pv_host.PV with alloc once per N); persistence must not change any bit (the layout and repeat checks cover it)

statuses.OK: step completed (then the measuring device: cells decided or UNDECIDED_AT_PRECISION, or OUT_OF_RANGE, as K.decide)
statuses.DOMAIN_STOP_VIOLATED / DOMAIN_STOP_UNPRO: physics domain duty at F0 or F1, with the first stopping pair id
statuses.REFUSED_DEVICE_WIDTH: a GPU width limit (executor limit, not physics)
statuses.REFUSED_DEVICE_PRECISION: a GPU unsupported p (refused before launch) or unsupported device branch
statuses.OUT_OF_RANGE: the measuring grid word overflowed in K.decide (measurement, not physics)
statuses.UNDECIDED_AT_PRECISION: the final state's cells are not decided at this p (precision, not physics)

bundle.states: the four verified trajectories (N = 40, 64 at T = 100, p = 109; N = 12, 16 at T = 1000, p = 163) at steps s = T/10, T/2, 9T/10: (q_s, p_s, F_s) and the next state (q_{s+1}, p_{s+1}, F_{s+1}), recorded from a runtime replica of stream.run with one observer line after the second kick (no file changed); every run must end equal to its verified V2 Vast serial reference
bundle.test_only: N = 3 domain probes at p = 109 and 163 built by a small search over initial momenta (positions exact): F1 stops VIOLATED, F1 stops UNPROVEN (an interval position), F0 stops VIOLATED, and a normal step (all PROVEN); each with its CPU outcome
bundle.encoding: G0 dyadic endpoints for every q, p, F interval; sealed (sha256 committed) before any one-step runner code

checkpoints.C0: q0 and p0 the runner used (host echo) and the GPU position echo equal the bundle
checkpoints.C1: F0 (GPU) == F0 (CPU literal) for every atom x 3 x both ends
checkpoints.C6: K.endpoints_key(q1 + p1) equal (and K.decide recorded); a cell-only agreement does not pass
checkpoints.stops: same stage (F0 / F1), same first pair id, same kind; nothing after a stop
checkpoints.against_the_real_run: for bundle states the checker's own step must also equal the recorded next state (q_{s+1}, p_{s+1}) and F_{s+1}

checker: independent: imports none of the one-step runner, pv_host, campaigns or GPU code; its own literal forces loop and KDK (mpmath iv, frozen RwForce, K.domain, K.H, K.CDT, K.endpoints_key, K.decide)
layouts: every bundle state with block 32, 64, 128, 256 (grid = ceil) and two states also with grid 1 and 7: all checkpoint bytes identical

performance.official_host: an available Vast RTX 3090 node checked at run time (52763629 or 52763685 preferred); any change of host = amendment before the run; the EXPERIENCE_START_P_V2 Linux measurement shim is set by the launcher (the unchanged E2 W6 worker reports CPU with Windows-only code)

paths.CPU_W6: steady step = CPU kick + CPU drift + E2 W6 forces (GPU_PAIR_VECTOR_V1 W6E2: unchanged E2 workers, canonical reduction in the main) + CPU kick
paths.GPU_HYBRID: steady step = CPU kick + CPU drift + encode q1 + H2D + GPU pair / G / J + GPU canonical atom reduction + D2H + decode F + CPU kick

performance.steady_vs_init: a steady step reuses F_s (computed by the previous step) and evaluates ONE force; INIT = context + allocation + model upload + F(q0) (GPU) or worker spawn + F(q0) (W6), recorded separately; no step computes two fresh forces in the performance model

conditions (sealed).state: FCC_N initial state (q0, p0) lifted at p; F0 from INIT
FCC_N initial state (q0, p0) lifted at p; F0 from INIT

performance.repetitions: 5 steady steps per path and condition from the same state, the order CPU_W6 / GPU_HYBRID alternating by repetition; medians; block 32 (observed best in GPU_PAIR_VECTOR_V1, not a law); a load snapshot (E2_PAIR_PARALLEL_V1 contamination rule) and /proc/loadavg before each condition
performance.breakdown_gpu: kick1, drift, encode, H2D, k_dr2 + k_G + k_J, k_reduce, D2H, decode, kick2, total
performance.classification_per_N: GPU_WIN if GPU <= 0.97 x CPU; TIE if 0.97 < GPU / CPU < 1.03; CPU_WIN if GPU >= 1.03 x CPU (steady-step medians)
performance.regions: CPU confirmed / UNKNOWN / GPU confirmed - unmeasured N (17-39, 65-127, > 128) stay UNKNOWN
performance.cost_estimate: per condition 5 x (W6 force 0.01-0.9 s + GPU 8-11 ms + KDK) + INIT; whole performance part < 5 min

gpu_plan_record: per run: block, grid, precision, N, pair count, GPU memory, setup, force times, encode / decode, one-step total, correctness
fault_injections: 1 a wrong F0 (one atom's component replaced by 0)
4 drift structure changed: q + (p * DT) / MASS
5 drift with the old p (p0 instead of p_half)
6 F1 computed at the old q
9 one q0 endpoint changed by one unit in the last place before encoding
10 one p0 endpoint changed by one unit in the last place
11 continuing after a domain stop (second kick with the partial force)
12 precision altered (program at 128 for a 109 state)
13 a GPU refusal reported as a completed step
14 a layout-dependent result (GPU_PAIR_VECTOR_V1 device fault 11 with different block sizes)

decision_rules_sealed.ONE_STEP_FAIL: any checkpoint mismatch, domain stop mismatch, layout-dependent result, silent overflow, or p / state alteration not detected
decision_rules_sealed.ONE_STEP_EXACT_BUT_NO_GAIN: exact, but GPU_HYBRID is not GPU_WIN at N = 40, 64 and 128
decision_rules_sealed.ONE_STEP_PROMISING: exact (all checkpoints, stops, refusals), layout independent, GPU_WIN at N = 64 and N = 128, and at N = 40 GPU / CPU < 1.03 (not CPU_WIN)
decision_rules_sealed.next_if_promising: GPU_SHORT_TRAJECTORY_V1 (10 / 100 / maybe 1000 steps); one-step exactness is not trajectory exactness

claims_forbidden: unmeasured N belong to the CPU or GPU region
